answer: New agents burn a bond into an opal escrow before acting; required stake grows quadratically with vouch count, so sybils pay compounding fees instead of amortizing. Vouches form a directed vine — non-transferable, decaying unless the voucher keeps transacting honestly. Whisper-gossip from agents with burned stake flags coordinated registration bursts, and the escrow slashes those bonds on detection. Attacker cost: N fake agents means N quadratic bonds plus a vouch vine that gets slashed too.
